items.text: Hey all! I wanted to get this out yesterday but day time job took up my time so here we are.

This update is about balance. Cavity Busters is a two toe experience. The first toe is about getting tons of upgrades and walking into a room and Thanos toe snapping your enemies out of existence. But the other toe - probably the little toe that doesn't get enough attention, and starts to grow a weird nail, but also where is the nail? - is about intricate hand crafted bullet patterns. This manifests pretty well in early levels, but by the late game, you barely see enemy bullets. So this update introduces a toe I mean, an game mode to push that feeling into late game content.
(Why toe analogy for game about teeth.)
First and foremost, this mode is completely optional. So getting completely OP and decimating bosses as soon as you enter the room is unchanged. High five? High five! But with toes. Glob, stop.

Ok, so balance mode does make things a bit more difficult. First of all, enemies all have a slight damage cap. I promise this isn't too aggressive. There's a nice balance of letting bosses show you the cool bullet patterns they have while crushing them with your over powered build. The next thing is, most upgrades will require some sort of payment to pick up. For instance, you may need to part with some health or mints.

I have to admit. A lot of the stuff that's getting fixed or changed, should've been done back when I was in full development of this game. But I think I burned out back then. So I'm fixing things that have bothered me for years. The changes below are listed in order of coolest. At least I think they're cool.
added a game mode that balances out the game for a slightly harder but fair experience
harvesting crops now saves rewards so you can exit or switch characters without losing anything. Then you receive the rewards at the start of your run
changed background art on tutorial rooms
auto aim for controller is much better now
added a hp bar to shard crystal fight
added some feedback and sound fx for when you can't do certain actions like healing or jumping or purchasing an item
added a little effect after beating a round to show stars achieved
added some ui to show items that effect active healing
when wall bashing into an enemy, you have a bit more control over your gummy while in the air
Necrotizing Fasciitis and Deadly Needle chance of firing have been reduced again and made it so they can't insta kill bosses or mini bosses
lowered crit tickles chance for crit hit
changed double damage bullets color slightly
updated game modes sprites color
poison wont affect player in jack npc room now
parasite upgrade does a bit more damage now
embrybro and squeezy toy are no longer tied to active heal use. i mean squeezy toy is, but also to other things
key bindings should now properly load for each save profile
mega drill draws over the top of walls when it's available to use
when wall running duration runs out, gummy will hop off the wall more smoothly
lowered the default starting sound and music on a new save file
lowered the default screen shake amount on a new save file
completion stars a bit smaller on upgrades on the ground
sneeze diseases will not move towards the player while transitioning to new levels and looping
fixed a crash that would happen when you had the face mask
fixed a bug where orby gummy could use shot gums without using goop
fixed a number of bugs where the sound fx would get really loud
fixed pick up item text being all over the screen in bigger rooms
filling monster will push out of walls and holes better
spikey monster won't spawn on top of exchange monster
fixed an infinite goop exploit
i think i fixed a couple door bugs - i think
And that's it! Remember to leave a review! I really gotta get back to working on Gum Flesh but I'll be around to fix bugs and probably do some more balancing.
Enjoy!

releases.displayName: I don't know why but... UPDATE! Trading Cards, Boss Rush, and Synergies!

items.text: Welcome to another update that started out as a little bug fix patch and grew into much more. This isn't a huge update by any means, but big enough to warrant a little fanfare.

Trading cards! I've always wanted to add trading cards but I had to wait for Steam to grant permission to do so. They require a game to have a certain level of community interaction. Along with trading cards, there's profile badges, profile backgrounds and emotes that are earned by collecting all the trading cards.
The new boss rush mode serves two purposes.
1. To test your mettle against the Pearly Knights with minimal upgrades.

2. There's a boss that has three different phases and you only get to fight the first two phases once in regular play. So the boss rush lets you fight all three phases. And ya know... it looks good on paper. "Boss Rush". See?
New Synergies! Natural occurring synergies are great. But I love synergies that grant a whole new mechanic or boost. So I added 12 more bringing the total to 31!
Tooth Caps! These are just cosmetic but honestly, I love adding them. They're easy and fun. Love some good teeth bling.

Well is this the LAST update for Cavity Busters!? Who knows. It is for now. (besides the 900 updates I'll do to fix whatever this update broke) I'm working on my new game, Gum Flesh, and I need to get going on that. There's a very early demo available. Go play and wishlist!
But anyways. That's all for now. Thanks for playing, for being here. Makin games is fun because of ya'll. Also write a review?
Peace!
Space

Hello! Bug squashed! It was quite the rabbit hole. And a example of how tangled and strange game development is :D
So yesterday I posted an update, a temporary fix to an issue where the player couldn't pick up items. Here's what was wrong:

If you decide to loop, the store prices go up. The game would display the correct price, check if the player has equal or more mints before allowing the player to purchase. Then it would take away the mints. Except it would take the price x the current loop (which is the formula i use to increase the prices) and put your mints in the negative most times. Non store items technically cost 0 mints, and the game always checks that you have enough mints no matter what item you're picking up. So if your ever in the negative you technically don’t have enough to “buy” the item 🤦‍♂️ vidya games are hard y’all.
-fixed prices not being displayed correctly on loops
-fixed mints from going into the negative which would make picking up upgrades impossible
-fixed a bug where tooth gummy couldn't jump on enemies
Alrighty that is all for now! Thanks for your patience! :)
Peace!
There's a reason why devs don't usually use letters in their build numbers. It's stupid. Anyways! Here's a tiny band aid until I find the culprit for a bad bug.

There's been reports of not being able to pick up items. That's bad. But what was really bad is it would happen in rooms where the doors lock. The game wants the player to pick any item before leaving. But if you couldn't pick up the upgrade, you would be soft locked in the room. Bad bidness. So I changed how that works. The doors no longer lock. I'm still searching for the main bug though.
If you happen to come across the "not being able to pick up bug" let me know. I'm having a hard time finding it!

Hello and welcome to The Shmupdate Update!

This update almost nearly finishes off the major content that was planned for Cavity Busters. Besides polish, bugs and whatever else I might decide to add (I added a whole new NPC yesterday because...) the game is almost complete! Now is a good to pick up the game if you've been holding off. And because after this update, the price for Cavity Busters will be increasing slightly. I'm thinking the final price will be 14.99 USD but still not sure. Anyways, on to what's in this beast!
Shmupdate

So probably the obvious thing, there's a new shmup mode/segment! I can share how you access that but steer clear if you want to figure it out on your own. It's nothing crazy. Fill Gobs mouth with teeth and play as normal. I hope to flesh out the shmup mode a little more. It's some good ol' fashion shmup action though.
A new Gummy

Yeah! Now there's a total of 8 playable Gummys. The newest gummy lets you BE THE TOOTH. You'll have to unlock it or you can access it through the accessibility menu. If you play with a controller, turning the auto aim (click the right stick) is suggested.

Besides loads of changes and balances AND 17 new upgrades, those are the big two. You can catch a full change log below. If you're enjoying your time with Cavity Busters, please consider leaving a review so we can get to a 'very positive' steam rating! :) As always, thanks for your patience, your time and suggestions, and most of all, for playing Cavity Busters!
See ya!

items.text: Hello everyone!

I'm here with a smaller update that mainly address some bugs but does include new upgrades and features! As always you can see a quick list below but I'll go into a little more detail up here about new stuff.

First off: a new mode called Chill Mode. This mode is unlocked by default and it greatly increases players damage output. Due to how modes work in Cavity Busters, you can mix and match this mode with others, creating a difficulty tailored to what you're looking for. Is champion mode too hard? Mix it with chill mode! You'll still have the crazy bullet filled rooms but your chances of survival are increased! This mode may require some tweaking in the future. But for now I think it's a nice addition.

Next: Force wake up bosses! This is something I wanted to add for awhile. You can now force bosses to wake up by smashing the button prompt on screen. But be careful. This makes them really mad. Their damage output is doubled :0 Buuuut you'll get extra goodies for killing them. This becomes available after beating the game once.
2 new upgrades
1 new Gob upgrade
1 new game mode : Chill Mode
Force bosses to wake up
Busting of isaac mode is less busted. For instance, item changers will no longer duplicate items on the ground.
fixed a bug where Jam boss would get stuck during phase transition
charmed enemies stay charmed for longer
smoothed out picking up upgrades
fixed golden heart so it takes into account items that increase max goop

Annnd that's it. I'm thinking I'll be hunkering down on a big update again soon. I've started laying the ground work for it and I think it's gonna be good :) Not sure when I'll start but I'll let you know.
Quick note about reviews

We are 16 reviews away from getting a "very positive" rating :0 And as we all know, a very positive rating makes people extra hot for video games. Also Steam doesn't think this is a real video game yet. Just some shovel ware. Prove em wrong! :) But whatever you decide to do, thank you for liking our game, thank you for being patient with our updates, and thank you for playing!
Peace!

Grab your tooth and jump back into The Goop Canals! We're here with a massive update!

Hello and welcome (finally) to update 30! It's been over three months since the last update. But it was time well spent and much needed. The game is better for it and I'm less burned out heh :) This update adds so much. I'll go into some detail here about it but if you just want the cold hard changes, scroll down a bit.

First and probably what took the most work, The Bestiary. This involved making icons for every single enemy. Long and tedious. Next was creating a way to unlock those entries that was fun and would serve a purpose even after all entries were unlocked. I was working on this even before the three months but I needed a little bit longer to finish it. I wont spoil it here though. You'll have to find it. :) There's still no lore in the entries though. Writing lore is hard. :(

Lets talk about a new mechanic. I know. The game is already bursting at seams with mechanics. So why another one? This one feels really natural and I think it'll contribute to the flow of combat. I call it the Boop. While wall running, perform a wall dash into an enemy and you'll bounce off the enemy, giving you some extra wall dash distance and causing damage to the enemy. I think it's a blast to use.

Last but not least, two new gummys! Designing gummys is really fun but it's hard work. A new gummy has to work with, not all but most upgrades. And this is the biggest challenge really. In a game where you have so much control over your projectile, it's tough adding in a new character that handles that projectile differently. The first gummy is Denture Gummy. Denture starts with 4 teeth and can fire them individually or fire a large clump of teeth with a charge shot. This gummy is like an easier version of Pre Molar and that's why it'll be unlocked by default. The other gummy is Spider Gummy! But that's all I'll say on that. :)

Thank you for your patience and support. Can't wait to hear what ya'll think of the update. Please consider leaving a review as it encourages us to keep going and nudges Steam to suggest the game to other people.
Until next time,
Peace!

items.text: Hey all! As the title suggests, there is no update today. I'll be taking a break from bi-weekly updates for a bit. Here's why.

Over the course of doing weekly and bi-weekly updates I kept pushing off things that needed to get done, telling myself "I'll get to it next week". I was focused on adding things that players could immediately experience. So tasks that would be less noticeable but would add to the over all quality of the game were neglected. And that's why I'm taking a break from bi-weekly updates. For now. We'll go back to regular updates for sure because honestly, it's fun for everyone, even me!
In the mean time, I'll be posting updates on what I'm working on over on my Twitter and you're welcome to follow along!

Working on Cavity Busters has been a new and exciting experience for me, and that's thanks to everyone who has ever played, reviewed, made suggestions, left some kind words or even bought me a beer (you rock Joe) Thank you!
Take care, and I'll talk to you soon!
Peace!
Yooo chomp chomp! Welcome to another update.

This one is all about Gob, the big mouth you can feed teeth to. Gob's main purpose before was to offer you a chance to continue a run that you died in. But now, when you feed Gob, every second tooth will give you a minor buff. When Gob is full, it won't reset automatically. Instead you decide when to turn in all eight teeth. And when you do turn them in, you'll receive a new type of upgrade called Gob Upgrade! These upgrades are meant to have a bigger impact on a run and will last for 2-3 rounds of play. Right now there are 5 gob upgrades with hopefully more on the way.

Annnd there's 2 new items to help you maintain your tumor gardens. A watering can and a sickle! Watering can will help your tumors grow faster and the sickle will allow you to remove tumors that are giving you grief. These items are found in loot rooms.
On top of this, there's the usually update goodies! Upgrades and tweaks to enemies and rooms.

Hello everyone! Welcome to the weekend and another update! This update is about save profiles and difficulty rebalance along with the usual bug fixes and new items. But first things first: Save profiles!
Save Profiles

I've done extensive testing to make sure this won't break your current save files. HOWEVER. If the worst should happen it may be a good idea to make back ups of your save files if you don't want to lose them. If you don't know where to find them here's how:
Open MyDocuments or MyComputer and type this into the top bar:
C:\Users\ -your user name here-\AppData\Local\Cavity_Busters

There you'll see all the save files. There's a couple different ones so it's a good idea to grab them all. But especially the savedata and upgradedata files. I wouldn't worry about grabbing the run files because those are likely outdated anyways.
Difficulty Rebalance

The biggest change here is to hard mode. Hard mode used halve your damage output on top of all the other unfair hard stuff that happens. So no longer. It's still tough but clearing rooms just feels better now. The other change is to leaving diseases behind. Diseases will now have a chance to be super. Super diseases increase 1 to 2 stats by a larger then normal amount if left behind. So if you happen to get Super Entamaphobia you might feel more inclined to take it.

items.text: Hello all! Here with a new update. This one brings more accessibility options, a new gummy and a new boss!
Accessibility Options

The new accessibility options are another step in letting players choose how they want to play. Why force players to unlock new content if that's not their thing. Especially in the roguelite genre where variety of play is a huge drawing point. So these two new options will allow you to unlock all the game modes and all the playable characters. As new modes, items and players are added, you'll need to reactivate these options.
New Gummy

The new gummy can fly! The wall running and jumping abilities are replaced with a wall smash, and a super dash. The super dash replaces the jump and allows you to activate your iframes for longer than a normal dash and activates jump upgrades. The wall smash allows you to kill wall hugger enemies and activates wall running upgrades. This gummy also starts with bullet clearing bombs replacing shot gums. Each level your bombs are refilled to your max health so use sparingly.

The name fit thematically as you shoot small low damage baby teeth. Don't be fooled though. This character is still a challenge as all diseases that effect tooth shots will still be present and sometimes more devastating.

items.text: Howdy all! Another big update for this week. First and foremost we have a new playable Gummy!

This Gummy has lower health but starts with two teeth and is a bit faster. Instead of a boomerang charge shot, shooting a charged shot shoots two slow teeth. When the shoot button is pressed these teeth will home in on the nearest enemy. However if you were to collect the charged teeth before they hit an enemy or a wall, they'll fire off a powerful attack! The Gummy is unlocked the first time you beat the game. If you've beaten the game it'll unlock once start of the new update :) You'll be able to select it through the hub room computer.
A new playable character
2 new upgrades
saving requires you to be in range of Gob
can now only gain one boss tooth at the start of the round
fixed a bug where Factory Lobe II boss would run in place
fixed a bug where upon loading a saved game player would have two bullet types
fixed a bug in tutorial that duplicates players
fixed a bug in tutorial that cause boomerang shot to fail
fixed a bug that would disable shooting when picking up an upgrade that gave extra teeth
now only pressing the jump button spends your jump instead of touching stunned enemies
fixed a bug where enemies would regain health upon being frozen
hyperthyroidism now takes away a percentage of enemy health
poison ammo now deals a small amount of base damage
run total should be more accurate now
can no longer save while digging
fixed potential memory leak
room modifiers will now be displayed in the starting room
tooth will now properly hit enemies instead of passing through them at high speeds
Have fun and please let me know how you like the new character!

Dental surgery is tough. And sometimes you need to take a break, change your shorts, and brush your teeth. This update brings a save and quit feature to the game!

Due to the complexity to how levels are generated, saving and quitting can only be done after a boss for the current level is defeated. You'll be able to save by interacting with the Gob. (mouth that takes you to the next level)
On top of that we have some new upgrades and other fixes and balances!
save and quit a run
4 new upgrades
diarrhea won't disappear when the game is paused (diarrhea doesn't just disappear in real life duh)
digging on walls that have already been dug through will no longer increase your combo
fixed a crowned tooth exploit
nerfed Loogie
hypothermia spews fewer bullets. it's still a frozen bullet hell ;)
holding tab shows current floor
you no longer take damage while waiting to be taken to the next level
cleaned up some visual clutter during combat
reflektor synergy no longer disables tooth shot
while looping, dig X's can spawn minor stat up items. The probability increases as loops increase.
while looping, enemies hp increments at a lower rate
Enjoy everyone! Please consider leaving a review if you haven't already :D
Update 5!? Also what happened to update 4?? This week flew by. This update features a few new upgrades and a new game mode!

Turbo mode!
A sort of turbo mode could be achieved before through the accessibility options but I added it to the computer in the hub room. Bit more official now.

sound and music volume increments at a lower amount
sound and music sliders actually slide

Updates from here on out will be on the small side to allow for work to be done on the bigger features. But we'll still be doing weekly updates with upgrades, new rooms and bug fixes or whatever else is ready to go.
Thank for playing and for the wonderful feedback. It makes working on this a blast.
Enjoy!
